source_record.title: Synthetic classification routing acceptance exercise
source_record.raw_text:
Synthetic classification routing acceptance exercise

AI classified 20 synthetic practice cases. Human reviewers corrected 4 classifications before any decision. The exercise did not measure time saved, learner outcomes, or revenue.
source_record.summary: 合成練習記錄20筆分類中4筆被人工修正；未量度時間、學習成果或收入。
key_points: 人工審核在20筆合成分類案例中修正4筆；未量度時間、學習成果或收入。
